subject: 🏃 Monday — Hip Complex Circuit (Wk 2)
html:
Tomorrow: Hip Complex Circuit — Week 2, Phase 1 Foundation (11 weeks to race day)

Twenty-minute mobility session, two rounds. No running, no load. Here's the circuit:

Round 1 & 2:
• Foam roller T-spine extensions (PT) — 8–10 reps
• Standing lunges with hip IR + extension (PT) — 8–10 each side
• Quadruped banded hip IR (PT) — 5–10 each side
• 90/90 switches — 8–10 each side
• Adductor rockbacks — 8–10 reps
• Quadruped hip CARs — 3 each direction, each leg (slow, sink into IR at bottom)
• Half-kneeling couch stretch — 60 sec each side

Context: Week 1 closed out clean — every session at knee 1/5, track intervals banked, heavy strength calibrated, and 8+ travel miles in Victoria on Saturday. The only blip was a 1.5/5 stretching awareness after the second crew run, inside the green band. This circuit is your reset before Tuesday's 6×800m at the track (7:15–7:25 pace) and the weekly volume bump from 17 to 24 miles.

Focus cue: Sink into the hip CARs. The PT flagged limited hip internal rotation bilaterally — this is where you chip away at it. Go slow, no momentum, feel the end range on every rep.

Prep: Lay out the band and foam roller tonight. This one's quick — 20 minutes, in and out. Get to bed by 10 so you're fresh for the track tomorrow.
